easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
